forum.title: How can I connect Lauterbach debugger to AEK-COM-10BASET?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello Team,

I found wrong cable connection and I successfully connected / started debugging through Lauterbach debugger.

Based on it's default basic CMM script I also flashed the sample project's ELF. Looks like working.

Thank you for help!
forum.content_text:
Hello support team,

I just received a new AEK-COM-10BASET board and trying to connect Lauterbach debugger with License module for MPC55xx.

Question : How can I connect to the board through Lauterbach debugger & SW?

Currently the SW (TRACE32) shows error message when I press "Up" button.

![apap_2-1777512866787.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/af216d3f-67ef-6a02-5e04-8e383d09d94f.png "apap_2-1777512866787.png")

I have no idea why such "Target Power Fail" error or "Power Down" message is appeared.

Also I checked below 11 pin and the measured voltage is 3.3V.

![apap_3-1777512975847.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/89141b27-21cc-982e-a144-b4554579263a.png "apap_3-1777512975847.png")

The jumper (switch) configuration I made are ;

JP1~JP7 : closed = short

J13, J14 : I tried both 1-2 and 2-3 connection

![apap_4-1777513103738.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9fa2d3b5-3ee1-1ce0-7edd-e40596c24930.png "apap_4-1777513103738.png")

Any comment is appreciated, thanks!

Best regards,

apap

scraped_replies.html:
Hello Team,

 

I found wrong cable connection and I successfully connected / started debugging through Lauterbach debugger.

Based on it's default basic CMM script I also flashed the sample project's ELF. Looks like working.

 

Thank you for help!
